newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank to promote stability in financial system.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank to promote stability in financial system.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Thursday that it will further promote stability, efficiency and security in the financial system.
"It is important to promote stability, efficiency and security in the financial system," Riksbank governor Urban Backstrom said in the bank's 1996 annual report.
"During 1997 we will increase our analysis and ambition in this area."
Backstrom said developments in the financial system were fast with new instruments, increased turnover and more cross-border trade.
The Riksbank would also prepare for a possible Swedish membership in Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU).
"As the parliament will not make a decision (about EMU membership) until the autumn of 1997, demand for flexibility is very tangible," Backstrom said.
"Irrespective of what parliament decides we must be able to quickly adjust our operations to this."
